<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Licenciement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/licenciement">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Licenciement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="Processus MPON" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Licenciement à notifier">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement" name="Envoyer le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPON" name="Licenciement envoyé">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement" targetRef="EndEvent_MPON"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="Processus MPOO" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Licenciement_Recu" name="Licenciement reçu">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Licenciement_Recu" messageRef="Message_Licenciement"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" name="Examiner le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Licenciement" name="Décision du MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Sopposer_Licenciement" name="S'opposer au licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement" name="Confirmer le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Licenciement_Conteste" name="Licenciement contesté">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Licenciement_Confirme" name="Licenciement confirmé">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Licenciement_Recu" targetRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Licenciement" targetRef="Task_Sopposer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Licenciement" targetRef="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_Sopposer_Licenciement" targetRef="EndEvent_Licenciement_Conteste"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement" targetRef="EndEvent_Licenciement_Confirme"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Dismissal_Sent" name="Dismissal sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="SendTask_Send_Dismissal"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO Process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review_Dismissal" name="Review dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" name="MPOO decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Oppose_Dismissal" name="Oppose dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm_Dismissal" name="Confirm dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Dismissal_Opposed" name="Dismissal opposed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Dismissal_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Dismissal_Received" targetRef="Task_Review_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_Review_Dismissal" targetRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" name="Opposes dismissal" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_Oppose_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" name="Confirms dismissal" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_Oppose_Dismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Dismissal_Opposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Dismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Dismissal_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
